resolutions.resolution: Merged control PR #359 adds scripts/world/terrain/streaming/terrain_streaming_manager.gd to WO-001 allowed_paths strictly for immutable P7.2 exclusion-bounds forwarding only.

The reviewer caveat assumed standard float32 Vector3. P7.2 acceptance is pinned to Godot 4.7.1.stable.double.custom_build.a13da4feb, where Vector3/real_t uses double precision. An executable probe at 1,737,400 m measured Vector3(1737400.02).x - Vector3(1737400.0).x = 0.020000000019 m and also resolved a 1 micrometre delta. The adversarial seam test now behaviorally requires 0.02 m to resolve at lunar radius, so a float32 build fails the acceptance gate rather than silently weakening clearance.

Removed source-string production-hook assertions. Replaced them with behavioral checks through TerrainStreamingManager.request_surface(), immutable deep-copy verification, collision-face equality against the final clipped mesh, LunarApp public activation/rollback behavior, and the exact-double lunar-scale precision guard.
